notes.title: Leaderboards!
notes.content: Added Leaderboards! Test your top scores against other players.

notes.title: Movement changes and attack effects
notes.content: Updated bear movement to better suit controller. Changed bear movement for keyboard to match controller movement. Added new attack effects when attacking enemies.

notes.title: Old Art Restored
notes.content: For consistency purposes old red room tile art restored. Newer art available in LightBear sequel

notes.title: High Def Bug fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug that may occur on high def screens.

notes.title: Added new Art and functionality
notes.content: Added new red room tile art. Can now knock monsters down holes. Player also more susceptible to falling too.

notes.title: Fixed some 3D models for projectile indicator changes
notes.content: Ghost, Blob, and Duck OBJ models updated to account for new projectile visual indicators

notes.title: Added more visual indicators to projectile enemies
notes.content: More visual indicators for projectile enemies

notes.content: Added some debugging info for older computers
